title: Quick Trade
description: Trade with villagers faster by just clicking on them
body:
Bulk trading kinda sucks in Minecraft, it takes so long to scroll through the trades when you only really need one. 


Just click on a villager once the mod is enabled and it will trade according to the rules set without even opening the villager gui!


![GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3cb4f4b78545519c3a77df1da6a4f2b912574ffe_0.webp)



Features
- press F10 to open GUI
- Toggleable
- Feedback in chat or above hotbar
- Completely clientside
- Enchant filtering
- Price and item limiting
- Turn on and off specific rules



![Trade](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e337b0770f4b326ffe2586b57dcd9bb8b88aaef_0.webp)
